# Telemetry 0x03 (receiver solution) golden case, body version 1
# (docs/proposals/STATION-ASSURANCE.md §2). The three UBX payloads are one
# epoch, little-endian as the receiver sends them, with bits the record drops
# set (validMag, psmState, headVehValid, correction age). body is the record
# body every implementation must produce from them. Regenerate with
#   go test ./internal/ingest -run TestReceiverSolutionGolden -update
